tool_metadata.tool_role: Internal Evidence Analysis & Problem Discovery Tool
tool_metadata.target_problem: CFM-01 (Vague-Memory Retrieval Failure at Stage G1)
tool_metadata.governance_label: Public-Evidence-Based PM Analysis — Not a Representative User Sample
tool_metadata.narrative: Public Evidence → Discovery Engine → Failure Mode → Root Cause → Solution → MVP → Synthetic Benchmark → Experimentation

stage_breakdown.stage_name: Stage G1: Query Formulation & Initial Search Surfacing
stage_breakdown.description: Vague prompt enters search, but un-tagged target media fails to surface in initial Top-K results.

stage_breakdown.stage_name: Stage G2: Candidate Result Browsing & Inspection
stage_breakdown.description: Candidate search returns partial matches, but session is abandoned due to lack of contextual timeline navigation affordance.

stage_breakdown.stage_name: Stage G3: Timeline Navigation & Context Expansion
stage_breakdown.description: User attempts manual date scrolling in main gallery timeline, losing anchor position or encountering missing EXIF metadata.

evidence_records.vague_query_prompt: Goa beach trip with friends sunset
evidence_records.target_photo_description: Beachfront shack dinner receipt and cocktail toast
evidence_records.primary_root_cause: Target photo lacks 'Goa' tag; search engine fails to surface target directly in initial results.

evidence_records.target_photo_description: Hot soup dinner photo at mountain cabin
evidence_records.primary_root_cause: Cabin dinner photo lacks GPS EXIF; keyword search fails to correlate hike with evening meal.

evidence_records.target_photo_description: Grandparents wedding album scanned physical print
evidence_records.primary_root_cause: Scanned photo has creation timestamp set to scan date (2024), stripping historical 1985 EXIF data.

evidence_records.target_photo_description: Expense receipt print lying on office desk
evidence_records.primary_root_cause: No anchor landmark photo present; isolated desk photo lacks spatial/temporal clustering.

evidence_records.target_photo_description: Group photo blowing candles at evening birthday dinner
evidence_records.primary_root_cause: Competing morning conference event at same city location causes context window overlap.

metric_decomposition.primary_metric: User VMRSR (User Vague-Memory Retrieval Success Rate)
metric_decomposition.formula: User VMRSR = (Unique active users with ≥1 vague search AND ≥1 operational retrieval success) / (Unique active users with ≥1 vague search)
